title: Blonde Boy on Boat, 1960s Outdoor Family Vacation B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid mid-1960s square black and white snapshot photo featuring a young blonde boy enjoying a sunny boat ride. He wears a classic white polo shirt and shorts, resting his hands along the glossy side rail of the boat while looking toward the camera. Bright sunlight illuminates the scenic natural backdrop of trees and hills, reflecting softly off the water and boat hull.
